svg.text: eight tables · one view · one write function
What I hold, what I am doing, and the words I am allowed to say it in.
provenance is mandatory: nothing asserts knowledge without a source
status ∈ held · confirmed · refuted · stale · superseded
one live triple: unique (subject, predicate, object)
where retired_at IS NULL · gin trgm (search_text)
decision ⇒ a claim or an intent · append-only
check (claim_id is not null or intent_id is not null)
git-versioned prose · the hinge only points at it
A subject and a predicate must exist before a claim
can name them. mem.assert_claim() does the
registration, the claim, the citation and the receipt
A citation carries its relation, so evidence against a
belief is stored the same way as evidence for it: a
claim can hold its own counter-source.
A belief leaves the live set by gaining retired_at. It
keeps its row, keeps its citations, and names its
successor; the chain is walked, never inferred.
The journal has no retired_at and no update path.
Beliefs may be revised; the doing of them may not.
one row per citation, not per document
reached through claim_source, read through the view
subject + predicate must be registered first
one live thread, with its journal of acts
the hinge into hippocampus; it points, never copies
crow's foot = many · tick = exactly one · sub-label = on delete action · GEN = generated · dashed = filename, not a foreign key
owned by user satan · database satan
